Messages.Author: wargrim
Messages.Body:
Dear players,
We would like to announce that Legendary Vampire Tournament will be held on 11th of November 2011 during EC 2011 in Warsaw.

We would like to invite TOP 20 players from the list below. 5 additional invitations will be sent to players, who proved to be TOP players in last years presenting great performance, and may have problems with getting to the TOP 20!
We will present invited players once we get confirmation that they are going to join EC2011 this year.

The list will be updated each time I receive confirmation that particular player is going to join the Legendary Vampire Tournament.

The rank is based on TWDA page with following rules.
For each tournament won in 2010/2011 a player is given points as below :
Ranking points = X*log5(Y), where :
X - modifier (5 - Continental tournament winner, 3 - NC winner, 2 - ECQ winner, 1 - other tournament)
Y - attendance for particular tournament

The list is still not closed yet - we are still waiting for people reporting tournaments till 30th of September 2011. The final list will be published on 1st of October 2011.
